confidence_note: Confidence is an evidence-coverage score for triage, not a calibrated probability and never a guarantee.

categories.label: Phishing / BEC
categories.description: Credential theft, impersonation, payment redirection, or social-engineering indicators.
categories.action: Quarantine and verify through an independent trusted channel. Do not click links or approve payments.

categories.label: Malware / dangerous attachment
categories.description: Executable, script, suspicious macro, file-type mismatch, or attachment payload indicators.
categories.action: Quarantine the file. Do not execute or open it on an analyst workstation.

categories.label: Banking / financial
categories.description: Banking, invoice, payment, transfer, remittance, or financial-service communication.
categories.action: Verify the sender and payment details independently before any transfer or account change.

categories.label: OTP / security alert
categories.description: Authentication code, password reset, suspicious-login, account-lock, or security notification.
categories.action: Never share an OTP. Use the official app or website rather than an email link.

categories.label: Delivery / order
categories.description: Shipping, parcel, order confirmation, tracking, return, or delivery update.
categories.action: Review the order reference and use the retailer’s official app or website for tracking.

categories.label: Promotional / marketing
categories.description: Sales, discounts, coupons, offers, product marketing, or unsubscribe-driven mail.
categories.action: Treat as marketing; use the sender’s legitimate unsubscribe flow if desired.

categories.label: Newsletter / digest
categories.description: Recurring digest, publication, blog, bulletin, or subscription update.
categories.action: Review as informational content; unsubscribe only through a trusted channel.

categories.label: Social / community
categories.description: Social-network notifications, community activity, comments, mentions, or invitations.
categories.action: Review normally; do not reuse passwords from links in notification emails.

categories.label: Corporate / internal
categories.description: Meeting, HR, payroll, policy, project, executive, or business-operation communication.
categories.action: Follow normal internal verification procedures for sensitive requests.

categories.label: Customer support
categories.description: Service desk, ticket, case, help, account-support, or customer-care correspondence.
categories.action: Check the ticket or case in the official support portal before sharing information.

categories.label: Transactional / receipt
categories.description: Routine receipt, statement, booking, confirmation, or service transaction.
categories.action: Keep for your records and verify unexpected transactions through the official service.

categories.label: Legitimate / general
categories.description: Routine correspondence without a stronger category signal.
categories.action: No high-risk signal was observed. Continue normal caution with links and attachments.

categories.label: Unknown / insufficient evidence
categories.description: Not enough reliable content to classify the message safely.
categories.action: Request more context or inspect the original message headers before acting.
